name: cuppazee
description: Read Munzee activity, collections, badges, inventory, ZeeOps, Gauntlet Games progress and bouncer locations through CuppaZee.

interface.longDescription: Ask about your Munzee activity, Munzdex collection, badges, inventory, current ZeeOps mission and Gauntlet Games progress. Look up individual Munzees and find bouncers by family or nearby location. Access is read-only: CuppaZee cannot capture or deploy Munzees, spend credits, or change your account.
